lede: Wat Hia accounts for 91 catalogued manuscripts, 25 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Nan (97% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Pua District. Nearly all (99%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (59%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (41%). Dated witnesses run 1549–1955 CE (50 of 91 carry a date).

findings.title: The temples of practical magic
findings.gloss: 3 temples whose catalogued holdings lean unusually hard toward magic-ritual texts — well above the corpus norm.
